items.title: Google Assistant will vanish from Android phones and connected devices in September
items.excerpt: Google is retiring Assistant across phones, Wear OS watches, cars and connected devices in September, replacing a decade-old voice interaction model with Gemini. The largest forced assistant-UX migration yet across consumer hardware.

items.title: Peloton Cross Training Bike+ review: A better connected bike that still demands a premium price
items.excerpt: Peloton's new bike builds an AI tracking camera into the hardware so the machine can watch and coach your form. A concrete example of computer vision moving from app feature to built-in product surface.

items.title: Google teases the Pixel 11 Pro and hints at a new camera bar feature
items.excerpt: A Google teaser shows an unexplained colored indicator ring beside the Pixel 11 Pro camera bar, hinting at a new hardware affordance ahead of the August 12 launch. Industrial-design signaling for an AI-camera phone.

items.title: Siri AI is coming to newer Apple devices only, here's the full list
items.excerpt: Apple published the hardware matrix for Siri AI across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Watch and Vision Pro, and older devices are cut. On-device model requirements are now openly fragmenting the install base.

items.title: MacPaw is building an on-device AI layer that will work across your Mac apps
items.excerpt: MacPaw and Liquid AI are co-developing an on-device AI stack that spans Mac apps rather than living inside one app. A third-party attempt to make local models a system-level layer for creative desktops.

items.title: Report: Apple's smart glasses will become a major health companion, but not initially
items.excerpt: Gurman reports Apple's non-AR smart glasses will start as an AI voice-and-camera device, with health sensing arriving in a later generation. A staged product roadmap for a category still searching for its use case.

items.title: After a week with Gemini Notebook on my Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, I can't imagine using it on a slab phone
items.excerpt: A week of living with Gemini Notebook on a foldable argues the AI research workflow only clicks on a large, split-screen canvas. Form factor, not the model, is what makes the tool usable.

items.title: Google quietly rewrote Chrome's AI documentation with important answers to on-device AI downloads
items.excerpt: Chrome's updated help pages finally spell out what on-device AI costs your machine, including roughly 20GB of free disk space for the local model. The hidden hardware tax of browser-resident AI, in writing.

items.title: Google can't catch a break as the Pixel 11 Pro leaks once again
items.excerpt: Marketing renders show a cleaner matte Pixel 11 Pro with the camera bar treatment extended and zoom pushed to 120x. Google's AI-camera flagship is leaking a week before Made by Google.

items.title: Nothing is using AI-generated people to show off its new earbuds – everyone hates it
items.excerpt: Nothing's CMF launched the Clip Pro earbuds with AI-generated models in its product imagery, and the backlash swamped the launch. A live case study in the credibility cost of synthetic product photography.

items.title: Google Home will fix broken Familiar Faces alerts on Walmart's Onn cameras
items.excerpt: Google is patching face-recognition alerts that broke on Walmart's budget Onn cameras running Google Home. AI perception features are now the thing that makes or breaks cheap third-party hardware.

items.title: Nothing reportedly prioritizing AI devices like its leaked smartwatch over smartphones
items.excerpt: Leaks suggest Nothing is shifting its roadmap toward AI-first wearables and audio devices rather than phones. A design-led hardware brand betting the next form factor isn't a slab.

items.title: Your Gemini for Home timers and alarms are getting smarter and more reliable
items.excerpt: The latest Gemini for Home rollout repairs timers and alarms and adds interactive storytelling on Nest speakers and displays. Google is patching the boring basics that the LLM assistant regressed.

items.title: Google expands Gemini Live to some of its oldest smart speakers and displays
items.excerpt: Gemini Live is reaching first-gen Google Home Mini and Nest Hub units nearly a decade old, via cloud inference. Old hardware gets a new interaction model without new silicon.

items.title: I gave a local LLM control of my entire homelab, and nothing ever touched the cloud
items.excerpt: A hands-on build wiring a locally hosted model into a full homelab, with tool access and zero cloud calls. Practical proof that on-device agents can run a real device fleet privately.

items.title: Google Assistant is disappearing from Android Auto soon, and Gemini isn't ready to replace it
items.excerpt: Android Auto loses Assistant next month while Gemini still misses core in-car voice tasks. A blunt look at what breaks when a mature voice UX is swapped for a generative one in a safety-critical context.

items.title: Apple is Reportedly Eyeing Fitness as the Killer App for Future Smart Glasses
items.excerpt: Apple is said to be aiming its second-generation smart glasses at fitness, not general assistance. A category still hunting for the one job that justifies wearing a camera on your face.

items.title: Snap to Show In-depth Look at 'Specs' AR Glasses in September Event
items.excerpt: Snap set a September 16 event in Los Angeles to detail Specs, its consumer AR glasses and developer platform. The last independent AR eyewear platform makes its pitch against Meta and Google.

items.title: The Meta Ray-Ban Display's Dumb Smart Glasses AI Is Dumb No More
items.excerpt: Meta is rolling its newer Muse Spark model onto the Ray-Ban Display, and the assistant finally keeps up with what you're doing. Evidence that model quality, not optics, decides whether AI glasses feel usable.

items.title: 25 New Things Your iPhone Can Do in iOS 27
items.excerpt: A catalog of iOS 27's shipping features, heavy on on-device Apple Intelligence: AI wallpaper extension, natural-language reminders and context-aware Siri actions. The AI phone's actual feature surface, not the keynote pitch.

items.title: Made by Google 2026 preview: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag and more
items.excerpt: A full preview of Google's August 12 hardware event: Pixel 11 on 2nm Tensor G6, Pixel Watch 5 and a Pixel Tag, all framed around on-device Gemini. The next reference point for what an AI phone is supposed to do.
